notes: Park Commission minutes, 1947 volume (the separate Park Commission before the 1950 merger, mostly maintenance contracts). Curated; dated by the page footers (m/d/yy) and the meeting openers.

coverage.remaining: War-years repair contracts, wartime uses of parks, and works with no page (Sutro Heights diorama house, the Golden Gate Park orchid house, Bufano statues at Aquatic Park) not placed.

findings.address_as_written: Marina Park - landscaping the area in Gas House Cove
findings.description: The Park Commission approved the plan for landscaping the area at Gas House Cove, the land the Army had given up at the Marina, and authorized a call for bids.

findings.address_as_written: three frame buildings to be erected in Portsmouth Square
findings.description: The Park Commission engaged the architect Leonard Mosias to draw plans for three frame buildings to be put up in Portsmouth Square for the California Centennial celebration, and to supervise their building; it approved his final plans on December 29, 1948.
